popCulture.title: Georgics
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil's fourth Georgic retells Aristaeus' bees and the Orpheus digression — the culture-hero of husbandry as Roman poetry's farming myth.

popCulture.title: Aristaeus
popCulture.description: Aristaeus remains the rustic god of bees, oil and the chase — the cycle of loss and restoration that taught Greeks to keep hives.
